vfkb.text:
Use YAML for CLI configuration files

Why: YAML is the industry standard for CLI tools (Docker, Kubernetes, etc.), offers better readability than JSON for human-edited config files, supports comments for documentation, and handles complex nested structures more elegantly. The js-yaml library dependency is minimal and well-maintained.

baseline.text:
CLI config files use JSON format via a minimal loader in src/config.ts

Why: JSON requires zero external dependencies, has native Node.js support, and is the standard for TypeScript/Node.js CLI projects. YAML would require an additional dependency (js-yaml) and added complexity without meaningful benefit for a CLI config system.
